country_decisions = {
	persian_nation = {
		potential = {
			NOT = { tag = MUG }
			if = {
				limit = { has_dlc = "King of Kings" }
				OR = { culture_group = iranian primary_culture = azeri_culture }
			}
			else = {
				OR = { culture_group = iranian primary_culture = azeri_culture tag = AKK }
			}
			is_colonial_nation = no
		}
		effect = {
			change_tag = PER
		}
	}
}
